mapper.select: SELECT raw.raw_attendance_fact_id AS rawFactId, event.point_instant AS punchedAt, raw.verification_method AS method FROM effective_attendance_event event JOIN evidence_link link ON link.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = link.raw_attendance_fact_id WHERE event.company_id = #{companyId} AND event.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND event.point_instant >= #{windowStart} AND event.point_instant < #{windowEnd} AND ( SELECT lifecycle.lifecycle_type FROM effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at DESC, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'ACTIVATED' ORDER BY event.point_instant, raw.raw_attendance_fact_id

SELECT raw.raw_attendance_fact_id AS rawFactId, raw.company_id AS companyId, COALESCE(event.employee_id, matched.employee_id) AS employeeId, COALESCE(event.point_instant, raw.source_instant) AS punchedAt, raw.verification_method AS method, raw.location_summary AS locationSummary, raw.source_coordinate_system AS sourceCoordinateSystem, raw.coordinate_validation_status AS coordinateValidationStatus, raw.coordinate_conversion_status AS coordinateConversionStatus, raw.map_longitude AS mapLongitude, raw.map_latitude AS mapLatitude, raw.map_coordinate_system AS mapCoordinateSystem FROM raw_attendance_fact raw JOIN evidence_link link ON link.raw_attendance_fact_id = raw.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN effective_attendance_event event ON event.effective_attendance_event_id = link.effective_attendance_event_id LEFT JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.employee_match_decision_id = link.employee_match_decision_id WHERE raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = #{rawFactId} AND ( SELECT lifecycle.lifecycle_type FROM effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at DESC, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'ACTIVATED' ORDER BY CASE link.link_type WHEN 'PRIMARY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, link.evidence_link_id LIMIT 1
